## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Xīnsuì jīng* is a single-fascicle Eastern Jìn 東晉 translation of the *Pavāraṇā-sūtra* — a parallel of [T61](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6a/KR6a0061) (Dharmarakṣa) and [T63](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6a/KR6a0063) (Fǎxián), all rendering essentially the same Indic discourse on the closing-of-the-rains-retreat (*pavāraṇā*) ceremony. The text opens at the Jetavana monastery in Śrāvasti.

**Abstract**

T62 was produced during Zhú Tánwúlán's Yangdu translation period (381–395 CE), recorded in the frontmatter. The Indic source is presumed lost. Together with [T61](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6a/KR6a0061), [T63](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6a/KR6a0063) and T26[121], T62 forms a four-fold cluster of pre-Saṃghadeva-and-Sòng renderings of the canonical *Pavāraṇā* discourse.
